name: Neotropolis
description: A retro-future neon city at night: green-on-black terminal glow, an amber grid sun, and a helpful robot named Volt.

mascot.name: Volt
mascot.idle: Volt, a little robot with a retro screen for a face, waiting calmly
mascot.happy: Volt the robot, smiling with happy squinting eyes
mascot.sad: Volt the robot, frowning with a drooping antenna

text.title: My Neotropolis Wishlist
text.welcome: Welcome to the grid. Everything here is on my wishlist. Priority items are the ones I want most. Tap the {i} on a photo for sizes, colors and notes.
text.footer: Compiled from a spreadsheet. End of transmission.
text.lootedNote: Already acquired and gifted. Thank you!
text.planner.idle: Enter a budget and I'll compute gifts that fit.
text.planner.claimHint: Bought one? Mark it acquired on its card so nobody doubles up.
text.empty.title: No signal
text.empty.text: No items match those filters. Loosen one or reset them.
